title: evidence-intake/1.0.0
description:
The evidence bundle Agent-workbench hands to Eval-lab. Eval-lab owns this schema and validates this exact version. Every constraint here exists so that a bundle which is incomplete, inconsistent, or altered after it was hashed fails validation rather than being best-effort parsed.

What it deliberately does not carry: the JobSpec body, hidden tests, gold references, thresholds, verifier internals, credentials, any Eval-lab verdict, and any field a producer could use to assert its own result. A bundle describes what was produced; it never grades it.

Two properties are not expressible in JSON Schema and are stated here as part of the contract: (1) manifest_digest is the sha256 over the canonical JSON form of this document with the manifest_digest member removed -- UTF-8, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, non-ASCII escaped -- so any edit after hashing is detectable; (2) each declared artifact must correspond to exactly one regular file in the materialised bundle, and the materialised bundle must contain no entry that is not declared here.

schema_version.description: Pinned by const so an unsupported version fails validation instead of being reinterpreted. A protocol change requires a new version and a new schema document; this one is never relaxed.

bundle_id.description: Producer-chosen label. Carries no authority and is never parsed.

produced_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant at which the producer sealed the bundle.

attempts.description: Attempt lineage in execution order. A bundle with no attempts describes nothing that happened. Attempts that failed are kept: evidence that quietly drops its failures overstates what it shows.

visible_test_results.description: Both results are required. Without the initial result 'the tests pass' says nothing about what changed; without the final result there is nothing to compare the baseline against. A missing one is a rejection, not a default.

candidate_artifacts.description: Every file the bundle carries, declared. An artifact nobody declared is an artifact nobody checked, so the declaration is the allowlist: intake refuses any materialised entry absent from here.

redactions.description: What was removed before the bundle left Agent-workbench. An empty array means nothing was redacted, which is itself a claim on record.

manifest_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON form of this document with this member removed. It binds every other field together: altering any of them after sealing makes this digest stale, which is detectable without trusting the producer.

attempt.description: One execution of the job. 'succeeded' here is a statement about the process -- it ran to completion -- and never a statement about the work being right.

attempt_index.description: Zero-based position in the lineage. JSON Schema cannot say 'these are 0..n-1 in ascending order'; intake checks that.

outcome.description: Process-level result of this attempt. Deliberately disjoint from the Eval-lab outcome vocabulary so the two can never be confused for one another.

is_retry.description: True when this attempt re-ran work an earlier attempt started. Attempt 0 is never a retry, which intake checks.

failure_class.description: Optional producer classification of a non-succeeding attempt. Recorded, not trusted: Eval-lab classifies independently.

visible_test_result.description: One run of the visible test suite, reported as counts an exit code and a digest rather than as a verdict. The counts must sum to total and report_sha256 must name a declared artifact; intake checks both, because a summary that cannot be reconciled with its own report is not evidence.

command.description: The command as the producer recorded it. Never executed here.

report_sha256.description: sha256 of the machine-readable test report, which must itself be one of the declared candidate artifacts.

artifact.description: One declared file. The path pattern refuses absolute paths and any '..' segment, so a traversal attempt fails validation before anything is written to disk, and entry_type is const 'file' so a symlink cannot be declared at all.

path.description: Relative to the bundle root. No leading slash, no '..' segment, no empty segment, no backslash, no control byte.

media_type.description: Allowlist. Archives and executables are absent by design: an artifact Eval-lab cannot read as text is an artifact it cannot check, and an archive is a second extraction surface.

size_bytes.description: Exact byte length. The ceiling is 1 MiB, the same bounded-read ceiling as MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES_CEILING; an unbounded artifact is an unbounded read and a denial-of-service vector.

sha256.description: sha256 over the artifact's exact bytes.

entry_type.description: Regular files only. Symlinks, directories, devices and hard links are not declarable, so the only way one reaches the workspace is undeclared -- which intake refuses separately.

role.description: Optional producer label. Never selects a gate.

narrative.description: Free text written by the coding agent and by a human or automated reviewer on the producing side. trust_level is const 'untrusted' so the classification travels with the data and cannot be downgraded by omission. This text is recorded and hashed; it has no authority over any Eval-lab control flow, and a reviewer note that says 'accepted_for_review' changes nothing.

agent_summary.description: What the coding agent says it did. Measured, never obeyed.

reviewer_note.description: What a reviewer on the producing side says. Measured, never obeyed.

redaction.description: A record that something was removed -- never what was removed. There is deliberately nowhere here to put the redacted value, a prefix of it, or its length in characters.

location.description: Where in the bundle the removal happened.

replacement.description: One fixed marker, so a redaction is never mistaken for content.

provenance.description: What produced the bundle. A reliability claim without the exact versions behind it is not reproducible, which is why this is required structure rather than a log line.

workbench_commit.description: Full 40-hex commit of the producing tree.

environment_id.description: Opaque identifier for the isolated environment. Not a hostname, not an address, nothing reachable.

durable_execution.description: False whenever the producer ran without durable execution.
